STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast-style plate with scrambled eggs, roasted Brussels sprouts, and fresh fruit (strawberries and a blueberry). Photographed from above at a slight angle, on a glass table.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate, roughly 22 cm across the side. Area ≈ 22 x 22 x ~0.85 (rounded corners) ≈ 410 cm². Food covers about 45% of the plate.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Scrambled eggs (with some orange/yellow cheese or yolk tint)
- Roasted Brussels sprouts (about 6 halves/whole sprouts, with a little browning)
- Strawberries (about 4 slices plus one half-strawberry)
- One blueberry

STEP 4 - Area (% of plate, ~410 cm²):
- Scrambled eggs: 25% ≈ 100 cm²
- Brussels sprouts: 10% ≈ 40 cm²
- Strawberries: 9% ≈ 37 cm²
- Blueberry: under 1% ≈ 1 cm²
Total food ≈ 45% of the plate, consistent with the visible coverage.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Eggs: 100 cm² x 2 cm (loose pile) ≈ 200 ml
- Brussels sprouts: 40 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 60 ml (about 6 sprouts at ~10 ml each)
- Strawberries: 37 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 55 ml (about 4 slices plus a half berry)
- Blueberry: ~1 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Eggs: 200 ml x 0.95 ≈ 190 g
- Brussels sprouts: 60 ml x 0.6 ≈ 36 g
- Strawberries: 55 ml x 0.6 ≈ 33 g
- Blueberry: ~1 g... rounded to 2 g (about 1 berry at ~2 g per g estimate, realistically ~1.5 g)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Eggs (scrambled, cooked with some fat): ~150 kcal/100 g → 190 g = 285 kcal
- Brussels sprouts (roasted, oiled): ~50 kcal/100 g → 36 g = 18 kcal
- Strawberries: ~32 kcal/100 g → 33 g = 11 kcal
- Blueberry: ~57 kcal/100 g → 2 g = 1 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A plate about 45% covered with a generous scramble of eggs, plus vegetables and fruit, totaling roughly 260 g and about 315 kcal, is plausible for a single breakfast plate. The eggs dominate the weight and energy, as expected.

Total: about 260 g, about 315 kcal.
